reason: Fresh-main Fast Landing diagnostic authorization for two remaining Facebook Worker audit findings. Source graph on fresh main proves FacebookRelayClient appends persisted WP-B execution/attempt/claim/owner/generation/hostGeneration/fencingToken identity to request URL query parameters, while the Worker index requires that identity from query parameters for physical desktop routes. The Worker event-delivery contract leases rows and supports ACK/expiry redelivery but has no lease-renew mutation, so long local processing can lose custody before ACK. These two findings share the Facebook relay/Worker delivery boundary and must be proven in one tests-only causal batch. Production scope remains zero until fresh Stage RED and Closure Matrix unknownBlockers=0; existing signed device authentication, canonical request signing, idempotency, D1 device-scoped lease/ACK fencing, retry/dead-letter semantics and WP-B persisted-attempt authority are PRESERVE.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact normalized repository-relative paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().

expectedFailures: Current backend/services/facebookRelayClient.js appends persisted WP-B execution/attempt/claim/owner and fencing identity into request URL query parameters; the diagnostic must fail until this identity is carried outside the URL while remaining bound to the signed request and validated by the Worker.

Current services/facebook-worker/src/desktopApi.js leases event deliveries and supports ACK/expiry recovery but exposes no matching-device-and-lease-token renewal mutation; the diagnostic must fail until a bounded lease renewal path exists and the client can renew custody during long local processing without weakening ACK fencing.

Existing device signature authentication, canonical request binding, persisted WP-B attempt/fencing identity, device-scoped lease token checks, idempotency and dead-letter recovery remain PRESERVE.
PR #615 and Desktop/Windows UAT candidate PR #538 remain untouched.
